title: POS stock, finance, and RBAC regression hardening

checks.name: pos_permissions_registered
checks.details: Default RBAC permissions must include the full POS permission family.

checks.name: admin_role_receives_pos_permissions
checks.details: Company Admin must receive POS permissions during role sync.

checks.name: cashier_role_is_limited
checks.details: Cashier can sell and print receipts without finance or cancel authority.

checks.name: pos_sale_creation_is_permissioned_and_atomic
checks.details: POS sale creation must be protected and run inside one transaction.

checks.name: pos_sale_requires_full_payment
checks.details: Completed sales must not be created with underpayment.

checks.name: pos_sale_validates_payment_account_scope
checks.details: Linked payment accounts must belong to the tenant and be active cash/bank/mobile-money accounts.

checks.name: pos_sale_decrements_stock_safely
checks.details: Stock decrement must be tenant-scoped and guarded against concurrent oversell.

checks.name: pos_sale_writes_stock_ledger
checks.details: Every completed POS item must create a negative stock-ledger movement.

checks.name: pos_sale_links_finance_cash_account
checks.details: When a payment account is selected, the sale total must increase the account balance.

checks.name: pos_sale_audit_log_recorded
checks.details: Completed POS sales must leave audit evidence.

checks.name: pos_product_search_is_scoped_and_bounded
checks.details: POS product search must avoid loading the full catalog and only expose active tenant products.

checks.name: pos_receipt_is_scoped_permissioned_and_not_cached
checks.details: Receipt printing must be tenant-scoped, permissioned, printable, and uncached.

checks.name: pos_shared_blocks_duplicates_and_bad_stock
checks.details: The shared validator must reject duplicate lines and impossible quantities before transaction side effects.

checks.name: pos_dashboard_uses_pos_endpoints_and_permissions
checks.details: Cashier UI must use the bounded POS endpoints and hide actions when permissions are missing.

checks.name: admin_permission_sync_endpoint_is_guarded
checks.details: Production permission repair must remain an authenticated POST-only admin action.

checks.name: package_exposes_pos_regression_command
checks.details: The regression suite must be runnable from npm scripts.
